allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'python','py','uv','pip','docker','node','npm','git','nvidia-smi','ollama','java','wsl'\) { $cmd = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { Write-Output \("FOUND    {0,-12} {1}" -f $c, $cmd.Source\) } else { Write-Output \("MISSING  {0}" -f $c\) } })
